title: Evaluation of a negation gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $i$ be a gate with earlier gate $j$. If gate $i$ negates gate $j$, then its value on $x$ is the Boolean negation of the value of $j$ on $x$.
